training.loss: mean visible-direction Laplace NLL for V plus mean all-direction Laplace NLL for A

controls.U1: constant scale per modality/seed from clean Train mean absolute residual, clamped to same range
controls.U2: inference-only mean of U3 scales over visible V directions / all A directions; broadcast
controls.U4: fixed seed20261109 permutation within visible V directions / all A directions; preserve relevant multiset
